title: Blast Radius observation record v1, revision 11 (shared by the downstream-test runner br_run.py and harness/run.py, plus Proof-of-Change PR runs)

poc_commit.description: OPTIONAL in the schema (rev 8) so a record written earlier still validates. The full git commit of Proof-of-Change that the daily run fast-forwarded to (origin/main) before it tested anything. ops/daily_run.py check_record requires this on every pr_run record.

runs_per_side.description: Completed runs per side. rev 3: minimum 0 here (a pr_run whose build failed ran 0 times); observation records still need >= 1 (else branch).

gxx.description: OPTIONAL (rev 13). First line of g++ --version on the machine that ran, or null when g++ is not installed. pandas needs that compiler to build. It does not affect the verdict.

PYTHONHASHSEED.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9). Recorded as 0, matching the fixed environment the tests run under. Absent on older records.

pr.description: OPTIONAL (rev 2). The PR under test when the run is a PR run, not a release pair.

base_sha_label.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9). Says base_sha is the pull request's base, which is not necessarily the main side that was tested.

tested_main_sha.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9). The main-side commit that was actually tested.

tested_main_sha_label.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9). What tested_main_sha is (base-branch tip, merge-base, or a nightly wheel commit).

claims.description: OPTIONAL (rev 2). What the PR or release says it does; same shape as a <run id>.claims.json file (docs/REPORT_SPEC.md). Statuses are computed by the report, never stored here.

upstream_commit_old.description: OPTIONAL (rev 2). Exact upstream commit on the old side.

upstream_commit_new.description: OPTIONAL (rev 2). Exact upstream commit on the new side.

per_test_outcomes.description: OPTIONAL (rev 2). Path (relative to logs) or sha256 digest of a per-test outcome table.

old_output.description: OPTIONAL (rev 2). Test id -> old-side output for tests that broke (a passing test usually has none: empty string).

golden_check.description: OPTIONAL (rev 2). Golden cases actually re-run with this harness version (not just re-read from stored records).

reviewer_decision.description: OPTIONAL (rev 2). The human approver's decision, written back after review.

record_kind.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3). Absent or 'observation': a release-pair observation (the original v1 record, all v1 fields required). 'pr_run': one Proof-of-Change run of an open PR, main vs PR (ops/daily_run.py); required fields are listed in the 'then' branch. 'verification' (rev 5): an independent checker's verdict on another record; required fields in the nested 'then'.

run_date.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Run folder date (YYYY-MM-DD, IST).

repo.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). owner/name of the upstream repository.

author.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). PR author login.

base_ref.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). PR base branch.

updated_at_utc.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). PR updated_at as given by GitHub (UTC).

updated_at_ist.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). PR updated_at converted to IST.

tested_at_ist.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). When the PR was tested (IST).

ci_state.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Upstream CI state seen at selection (passing, pending, failing, none, or a note).

ci_detail.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Free-text detail for ci_state.

files.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Touched files, classified.

what_changed.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Touched files for the report.

route.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). How main and PR sides were built.

runs_per_side_planned.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Runs per side the protocol asked for (3).

build_timeout_s.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Timeout for source builds.

posted_upstream.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Always false: the runner never posts to GitHub.

freeze.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). pip freeze file names per side (main, pr), inside the PR's log folder.

main_side.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). How the main side was set up (version, pip check, test extras, optional test deps).

main_build.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Exact nightly wheel used for main: filename, url, sha256, size, build date, upload time, commit.

pr_side.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). How the PR side was set up.

sides.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). source-pair route: comparison basis, main_sha, pr_sha, merge_commit, merge_parents.

tested.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Human-readable statement of exactly what was tested on each side.

test_targets.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Test files run per side (main, pr).

test_extras.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Test extras of the project installed on both sides (source-pair route).

comparison.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Per-test comparison: same, regressions, fixed, new_tests_passing, new_tests_failing, removed_tests, reparametrized, skipped_missing_dependency, flaky, other_changes, preexisting_failures, messages. Rev 9 adds environment (a pass/skip change for a resource limit on both sides) and backend_same_error (a new failure whose exception also happens on the base side after an optional module was installed).

exit_check.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Whether every non-zero pytest exit is explained by identical failures on both sides.

verdict.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records; rev 12 adds no_code_change). Proof-of-Change verdict.

reason.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). One-line reason for the verdict.

head_moved.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). True when the PR head moved after the day's selection; the pinned head was tested.

current_head_sha.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). PR head at test time.

frozen_from.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Earlier attempt of the same run date that first selected this PR.

state.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). PR state at test time.

mergeable.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). GitHub mergeable flag.

schema_errors.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records). Validation errors found by the runner when writing the record (should be absent).

changed_lines_total.description: OPTIONAL (rev 4, coverage gate). Changed or added executable lines in the PR's non-test Python files (coverage.py's executable lines, PR side). null = not measured.

changed_lines_covered.description: OPTIONAL (rev 4, coverage gate). How many of changed_lines_total were executed by the PR side's test subset (one extra, untimed coverage run). null = not measured.

coverage.description: OPTIONAL (rev 4, coverage gate). Raw result of the coverage run: status (measured|failed|not needed|skipped), why, seconds, log, changed_lines_total, changed_lines_covered, files[{file, changed_lines_total, changed_lines_covered, note}].

coverage_gate.description: OPTIONAL (rev 4, coverage gate). What the coverage gate decided (poc/coverage_gate.py): kind (python|compiled|compiled+python|no-executable-change|unknown), changed (did it change the verdict), confidence (normal|lower|none), note. Rev 6 adds measurement: measured | not measured: predates gate | not measured | not needed.

verdict_before_coverage_gate.description: OPTIONAL (rev 4, coverage gate; rev 12 adds no_code_change). Verdict from the test comparison alone, before the coverage gate.

reason_before_coverage_gate.description: OPTIONAL (rev 4, coverage gate). Reason from the test comparison alone, before the coverage gate.

chosen.description: OPTIONAL (rev 3, pr_run records; renamed in rev 4). Chosen-PR entry (install/test commands) when the PR was chosen by name for the day.

verification.description: OPTIONAL (rev 5; required when record_kind == 'verification'). An independent checker's verdict on ONE existing record (normally a pr_run). The checked run's verdict (verdict_under_review) and the checker's own verdict (checker_verdict) live in separately named fields so neither can be read as the other; there is no top-level verdict.

checker.description: Who did the independent check (not the author of the checked run).

target.description: The record being checked. record_id is the checked record's 'id' (for pr_run: pr-<owner>-<repo>-<number>-<head12>-<run_date>).

verdict_under_review.description: The CHECKED RUN's verdict (the run author's), exactly as it stood when the check was made. Never the checker's verdict.

as_of.description: Report or record version the verdict was read from, with an IST time.

checker_verdict.description: The CHECKER's own verdict. null = the checker did not re-check this record (check_status 'unverified').

check_status.description: verified_by_checker: checker re-ran/probed and agrees with verdict_under_review. mismatch: checker re-checked and checker_verdict differs from verdict_under_review.verdict. unverified: not re-checked (checker_verdict null).

mismatch_on.description: What differed when check_status is mismatch.

counts_reproduced.description: Checker's re-run reproduced the run's per-side test counts exactly (null = not re-run).

summary.description: One plain sentence naming both sides, e.g. 'The run said needs_attention; the checker says verified.'

later_run_verdict.description: OPTIONAL. The checked record's verdict at a later time (same record id), so readers can see whether the run author has since changed it.

probes.description: OPTIONAL (rev 6; rev 7 adds generator, freeze, refused and source diff; rev 9 adds status uninformative; rev 14 adds crashed and rejected). Probes run on both sides of a PR (poc/probes.py): small deterministic scripts whose JSON observations are compared by plain code. status none = the PR has no probe. status uninformative = every probe saw only the same exception on both sides, so it did not count as ran. status crashed = a probe stopped on the main side. status rejected = every probe was rejected.

source.description: library: a fixed probe from probes/<owner>/<repo>/<pr>.py; model: a model-written probe; diff: a model-free differential probe (rev 7, baseline tests+diff)

status.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9; rev 14 adds crashed and rejected). ran = the probe observed the function; uninformative = every input raised the same exception on both sides; not_run = no type-aware input could be built; error = the probe produced no observations; crashed = every main-side run stopped; rejected = the probe checked none of its claims.

uninformative_reason.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9). Why this probe did not count as ran.

expect.description: What the claim says about main vs PR for the covered observations.

outputs.description: Saved output files (one observation per line), relative to the PR's run folder

runs.description: Recorded observations of every run, {name: value} per run, so results can be re-judged without the environments

state.description: poc.diff.confirm over the runs of both sides.

label.description: poc.verdict.FindingLabel value (see poc/probes.py for the rules).

claim.description: id of the claim that covers this observation, null if none does

diffs.description: poc.diff.compare field-level differences (field relative to the observation value)

citations.description: Line of the observation in the saved probe output of run 1 of each side.

generator.description: OPTIONAL (rev 7). Who wrote the probe (poc/freeze.py generator). Only kind model with provider nebius that passed the freeze rule is blind; fixed probes (post-hoc or hand-written), recorded fixtures and differential probes are not.

freeze.description: OPTIONAL (rev 7). Freeze of the probe before any PR-side execution (poc/freeze.py): content sha256, generator, time, and the sha256 of the generation inputs (PR text and base-side files; null for hand-written probes). verified: the probe matched its freeze before every PR-side run.

generator.description: OPTIONAL (rev 7). Who wrote the probe (poc/freeze.py generator). Only kind model with provider nebius that passed the freeze rule is blind; fixed probes (post-hoc or hand-written), recorded fixtures and differential probes are not.

refused.description: OPTIONAL (rev 7). Probes not run on the PR side because they failed the freeze rule.

behaviour_claims.description: OPTIONAL (rev 6; rev 9 adds sources changelog and docstring, and an optional status). Behaviour-preservation claims (poc/behaviour_claims.py), each {source, quote, pattern}. Without a probe whose claims expect 'same', a verified PR with such a claim becomes could_not_verify. status 'holds by construction' means a docstring-only change.

status.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9). Set when a docstring-only change makes the claim hold by construction.

baseline.description: OPTIONAL (rev 7). What decided the verdict (ops/daily_run.py --baseline): tests = test comparison only; tests+diff = plus model-free differential probes; tests+probes = plus claim probes (fixed and/or model); full = everything (claim probes, coverage gate, claim flagging; differential probes informational). Records without it are full.

model_provider.description: OPTIONAL (rev 7). Model provider of the run (--model-provider) and what was actually used; note says when the run fell back to fixed probes only.

model_provider_used.description: OPTIONAL (rev 10). The model provider that actually completed a call. none means the AI did not run: it was turned off, a call was skipped, or a call failed. This is what ran, not the provider the run was asked to use.

model_provider_fallback.description: OPTIONAL (rev 10). Set when the AI was off, a call was skipped, or a call failed. Absent when the provider that was asked for completed its calls. Never contains an API key.

swarm_requested.description: OPTIONAL (rev 11). Whether this run asked for the advisory swarm, from the --swarm flag or POC_SWARM. True means the switch was set, even when the step was skipped. This is the setting, not whether the step ran.

operator_approval_requested.description: OPTIONAL (rev 11). Whether this run had operator approval turned on (POC_HITL). True means the switch was set, even when the approval step was never reached. This is the setting, not whether the step ran.

swarm.description: OPTIONAL (rev 11). Whether the advisory swarm step ran. on means the step ran. off means it did not. This is what ran, not whether the run asked for the swarm.

operator_approval.description: OPTIONAL (rev 11). Whether the operator-approval step ran. on means the step was entered. off means it was not. This is what ran, not whether the switch was set.

probe_plan.description: OPTIONAL (rev 7). Probes written and frozen before PR-side execution: baseline, model note, extracted/rejected model claims, differential targets, frozen probes, errors.

pr_side_started_at.description: OPTIONAL (rev 7). When the first PR-side execution (install, build or patch) started; probes frozen later are refused.

head_at_report_sha.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9). Pull-request head on the forge when the report was written.

head_moved_since_test.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9). True when head_at_report_sha differs from the head that was tested.

tested_invocation.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9). Which invocation of this run folder tested the pull request. A later --resume keeps the earlier record.

docstring_only.description: OPTIONAL (rev 9). True when every changed Python file has the same AST after docstrings are removed.

description: One JSON object per (upstream, old, new, dependent) tuple, one line in observations.jsonl and research/runs/<id>/record.json. Merged 2026-10-10 from runner v1 (gates, accepted, network, report, stability, dependent_import) and guardrails/schema.py (hand_check, upstream_issue, machine_type, thread_env, per_run.collection_errors, per_run.pytest_summary). Cross-field rules not expressible here are listed in x-cross-field-rules and enforced by harness/brlib.py validate(). Revision 2 (2026-10-10, from docs/REPORT_SPEC.md): adds OPTIONAL pr, claims, upstream_commit_old/new, per_test_outcomes, old_output, golden_check, reviewer_decision for the reviewer report. Purely additive: every rev 1 record stays valid, schema_version stays "1". hand_check and upstream_issue were already present (required, nullable) and are unchanged. Accepted schema_sha256 values for rev 1 and rev 2 are listed in harness/schema/README.md and guardrails/schema.py.
x-cross-field-rules: per_run has exactly runs_per_side entries for each side, and runs_per_side >= 3 when classification is not null
classification is null only when accepted is false (the runner refused to classify)
accepted is true only if every gate with required != false has pass == true
env_diff is exactly [upstream==old_version, upstream==new_version] (or empty for an A/A control with old == new)
import_failure counts test MODULES, not tests; lost_tests are not counted as real_break
pr_run: runs_per_side counts completed runs (0 when the build failed); verdict is could_not_verify when runs_per_side < runs_per_side_planned
changed_lines_covered <= changed_lines_total when both are integers (rev 4).

x-revisions.change: optional reviewer-report fields: pr, claims, upstream_commit_old, upstream_commit_new, per_test_outcomes, old_output, golden_check, reviewer_decision

optional record kind 'pr_run' (record_kind field; Proof-of-Change PR runs from ops/daily_run.py). The v1 required list moved into the 'else' branch unchanged, so records without record_kind validate exactly as before; runs_per_side minimum 1 also moved there (pr_run allows 0). New keywords: if/then/else/const.

optional coverage-gate fields: changed_lines_total, changed_lines_covered, coverage, coverage_gate, verdict_before_coverage_gate, reason_before_coverage_gate. Nothing becomes required. Also: the optional chosen-PR property was renamed `chosen` (optional, so older records stay valid), descriptions and revision authors made neutral.

optional record kind 'verification' with one new optional property 'verification' (checker, target, verdict_under_review, checker_verdict, check_status, evidence; no top-level verdict). The rev 3/4 'else' branch (observation records) moved unchanged one level down into a nested if/then/else, so observation and pr_run records validate exactly as before. Keywords unchanged (if/then/else/const/enum/type).

optional pr_run properties `probes` (probe results: claims, recorded runs, per-observation state, label, field differences and citations) and `behaviour_claims` (behaviour-preservation claims quoted from the PR title or description), and optional coverage_gate.measurement (measured | not measured: predates gate | not measured | not needed). Nothing becomes required; rev 1-5 records stay valid.

optional pr_run properties `baseline` (tests | tests+diff | tests+probes | full), `model_provider`, `probe_plan` and `pr_side_started_at`; probe items gain optional `generator` and `freeze` (freeze rule) and source `diff`; probes gain optional `refused`. Nothing becomes required; rev 1-6 records stay valid.

optional pr_run property `poc_commit`: the full git commit of Proof-of-Change (origin/main) that the daily run fast-forwarded to before testing. Nothing becomes required in the schema, so rev 1-7 records stay valid. The daily run's record check requires the field on a pr_run record.

optional additions only: probes.status uninformative; probe item status (ran, uninformative, not_run, error) and uninformative_reason; behaviour_claims sources changelog and docstring, plus optional status 'holds by construction'; thread_env.PYTHONHASHSEED const 0; pr.base_sha_label, pr.tested_main_sha, pr.tested_main_sha_label; head_at_report_sha, head_moved_since_test, tested_invocation, docstring_only. Nothing becomes required, so rev 1-8 records stay valid.

optional pr_run properties model_provider_used (nebius, recorded, or none: the provider that actually completed a call) and model_provider_fallback (set when the AI was off, a call was skipped, or a call failed). Nothing becomes required, so rev 1-9 records stay valid.

optional pr_run properties swarm_requested and operator_approval_requested (whether the switch was set) plus swarm and operator_approval (on or off: whether that step ran). Nothing becomes required, so rev 1-10 records stay valid.
verdict and verdict_before_coverage_gate may be no_code_change. Nothing becomes required, so rev 1-11 records stay valid.
optional machine_type.gxx (the g++ version line, or null). Nothing becomes required, so rev 1-12 records stay valid.
probes.status and each probe item status may be crashed or rejected. Nothing becomes required, so rev 1-13 records stay valid.
observation label and summary labels may be unstable_on_pr (stable on the base, unstable only on the pull request). Nothing becomes required, so rev 1-14 records stay valid.
